meta.title: Best Workforce Services | A clearer route to contract growth
meta.description: A personalised website, enquiry response and contract pipeline proposal prepared for Francois and Best Workforce Services.

announcement: A PRACTICAL GROWTH SYSTEM FOR BEST WORKFORCE SERVICES

hero.body: From its Edinburgh base, Best Workforce Services already offers the people businesses need across security, cleaning, hospitality, reception, housekeeping, social care and delivery. The opportunity is to turn that breadth into a sharper contract journey: help each buyer find the right team, show credible proof and give every genuine enquiry a visible next step.
hero.note: Prepared around the current public website, service portfolio and direct-contract ambition.

review.title: Make a broad workforce offer feel simple to buy.
review.intro: The current website proves that Best Workforce Services covers a wide range of operational needs. The next step is to organise that breadth around the buyers you most want, strengthen the evidence behind the offer and connect every serious enquiry to a practical contract process.

cards.title: Create focused routes for each buyer
cards.body: Separate security, cleaning, hospitality, social care and staffing needs into clear journeys, then lead with the services and contract types Best Workforce Services wants to grow first.

cards.title: Turn capability into buyer confidence
cards.body: Present approved credentials, supervision standards, service processes, team experience and client evidence where procurement teams expect to find them.

cards.title: Keep every serious enquiry moving
cards.body: Connect calls, forms and messages to one follow-up view so the right person can see the requirement, owner, deadline and next action.

review.callout: The aim is straightforward: make Best Workforce Services easier to understand, easier to shortlist and easier to engage for the next contract.

video.title: See how the moving parts fit together.
video.body: The Delivery 101 walkthrough shows the website, response and follow-up principles behind the proposal. The final implementation would be adapted to Best Workforce Services and its confirmed contract-enquiry process.
video.note: Clear enquiry capture, missed-call response, follow-up ownership and a visible pipeline.

roadmapIntro: Start by sharpening the commercial story. Then connect the response process and use real enquiry evidence to decide where the next investment will have the most value.

roadmap.title: Position the business for the right contracts
roadmap.body: Align the public identity, choose priority services and buyers, and organise approved proof around what procurement teams need to know.
roadmap.result: A buyer can quickly understand the relevant service, coverage and next step.

roadmap.title: Capture and qualify every requirement
roadmap.body: Connect the retained call, form and message routes to a consistent response process that records service, location, timing and decision path.
roadmap.result: Each serious enquiry has a clear owner, requirement and next action.

roadmap.title: Manage the contract pipeline
roadmap.body: Use a simple view for qualification, site visit, proposal, decision, mobilisation and future follow-up.
roadmap.result: Open opportunities, deadlines and overdue follow-ups are easy to see.

ownership.title: The work is built to stay with BWS.
body: We will rebuild the website and set up the system so Best Workforce Services is investing in an asset it can keep.
We will clearly separate client-owned work from phone, messaging, CRM and other third-party services that may have their own billing or transfer terms.
items: The rebuilt BWS website and client-specific content
The approved design, copy, pages and business information
Your domain and approved brand assets
Your customer, enquiry and contract-opportunity data
A clear handover route if you ever leave us
ownership.footnote: Any separate third-party subscriptions and their transfer terms will be identified clearly before setup.

pipeline.title: Know what is happening next.
pipeline.intro: The stages can be matched to the way Francois and the team qualify, price and mobilise contract work.
pipeline.caption: A practical view for the opportunities that matter, without turning the team into software operators.

offer.title: Start with the foundation. Improve from evidence.
body: The first phase makes Best Workforce Services easier to understand, trust and contact. Then we use real enquiries and contract activity to decide what deserves attention next.
That creates a foundation that can keep improving without relying on disconnected tools or lost follow-ups.
offer.label: Best Workforce Services system
offer.detail: The connected foundation to get the system live and working.
items: Ongoing improvements within the agreed scope
offer.guarantee: No separate upfront website build fee. 30-day money-back guarantee.

faq.question: What would we improve first?
faq.answer: We start by aligning the public identity, choosing the priority services and buyers, and giving each contract enquiry a clear route from interest to next action.

faq.question: Do I keep the website if I leave?
faq.answer: Yes. The BWS website, its client-specific content and the work created for the business remain yours. Any separate third-party subscriptions and transfer terms will be documented clearly.

faq.question: Can the system cover every service immediately?
faq.answer: The existing service portfolio can remain visible, but the strongest launch will prioritise the services and contract types Francois wants to grow first, then expand from evidence.

faq.question: What happens next?
faq.answer: We confirm the priority services, target buyers, current enquiry process and access. Then we map the first implementation phase and begin building the connected foundation.
